title: Reinforcement Learning, Optimal Control, and Bayesian Filtering in Data Assimilation
summary: We give a finite-horizon variational formulation that places Bayesian filtering and smoothing, variational data assimilation, KL-regularized control, and Kalman-type methods inside one mathematically explicit hierarchy.
